$comment: Per-fork config consumed by scripts/substitute-config-placeholders.sh. Copy this file to .gembaflow-config.json and fill in your values, then run /bootstrap-workflow or substitute-config-placeholders.sh directly. The three fields are substituted into {{org}} / {{bot.worker}} / {{bot.reviewer}} placeholders inside .claude/commands/*.md. See docs/PLATFORM-GUIDE.md for the templating convention. legacy.githubProjects (default false) is the DEPRECATED one-release GitHub-Projects compatibility flag: beads (bd) is the tracker; set it to true only while finishing a migration off a GitHub Project board (scripts/migrate-issues-to-beads.sh), and add board.id (the project board number) back only if the legacy path needs it. Workflows read the same flag from the GEMBAFLOW_LEGACY_GITHUB_PROJECTS Actions variable because this file is gitignored. See docs/BEADS.md.
